meta.goal_verbatim: Design a battery for a next-generation pure electric sedan: energy density >= 392.61 Wh/kg, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60 C, overcharge to 4.7 V without triggering thermal runaway
meta.task_origin: headless zero-interaction session; no clarification possible -> widest degree-of-freedom interpretation recorded in freedoms
meta.start_stage_basis: task text names no new materials/additives/electrolyte design -> Stage 3 cell design start; material escalation remains available via ceiling_escalation (on)

threshold_parsing.maximum temperature <= 60 C: stage3 T_max_K <= 333.15 K (60+273.15); applied to every simulated scenario (4C fast charge AND overcharge)
threshold_parsing.4C fast charge without lithium plating: stage3 plated == false; 4C_charge_45C protocol with --plating, anode_potential_v min >= 0 V
threshold_parsing.overcharge to 4.7 V without thermal runa: stage3 triggered == false; overcharge protocol charges to upper cut-off +0.5 V, so 4.7 V target implies 4.2 V upper cut-off systems (Chen2020/OKane2022 family); run-tr --sim mechanical coupling
threshold_parsing.base_parameter_set: task names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 with record; system switching allowed under freedoms

objective_breakdown: ED >= 392.61 Wh/kg (stage2, calc-energy contract formula, electrolyte excluded); 4C fast charge at 45C ambient with no lithium plating (stage3: plated=false, anode_potential_v min >= 0 V); maximum temperature <= 60 C in every simulated scenario (stage3: T_max_K <= 333.15 K, incl. overcharge); overcharge to 4.7 V without thermal runaway (stage3: triggered=false, overcharge protocol 0.5C to upper cut-off +0.5 V => pins 4.2 V cut-off NMC811-family systems). Pareto: thicker electrodes raise ED but worsen 4C heating and plating margin (N/P up helps plating, adds mass); thin CC/separator raise ED without electrochemical penalty; cooling h and particle size are the main safety levers.
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline: Chen2020 (anchor-table default, task names no system; recorded) 1C discharge + calc-energy, 4C charge with plating, overcharge + run-tr. Opening ceiling assessment decides: architecture-only achievable -> Stage 3 loop; else escalate to Stage 2 (high-capacity SiOx anode custom system JSON with literature values, or electrolyte formulation). ED ladder: thin current collectors (Al 16->8um, Cu 12->6um), thin separator (12->8um, porosity up), anode supply up if anode-limited (negative thickness/active fraction), cathode loading up, porosity up. Safety ladder: h 10->20-50, negative particle radius 5.86->2-3um, electrolyte sigma/t+ up, N/P up. Exploration force ON: 2-4 variants per round, SPMe first, DFN for finalists.
budget_allocation: R1 baseline+ceiling; R2-R6 ED architecture loop; R7-R10 safety loop (4C+overcharge+run-tr); R11-R15 joint fine-tuning, DFN re-verification, closing. No round cap; trim/extend per fallback routing.
risk_and_fallback: R1: ED ceiling < 392.61 -> ceiling assessment attributes gap to material capacity/voltage (Stage 2 escalation: SiOx anode system or electrolyte) vs mass overhead (Stage 3 architecture). R2: 4C plating persistent -> particle size down, electrolyte sigma up, N/P up, cooling up; three-strike questioning if still failing. R3: overcharge T_max > 60C or run-tr triggered -> cooling h and resistance reduction; run-tr must use --mass-kg (t7_r1 lesson); honest negative record if mechanically unavoidable. R4: solver failures -> read error verbatim, fix legality, rerun (DFN auto-degrades to SPMe). R5: Chen2020 first-cycle low-capacity artifact (discharged initial state) -> do not compare first cycles across systems. Three-strike rule active with layer-by-layer questioning and plan-update entries.

detail: start_stage=3: this case starts at Stage 3 cell design; materials use system baseline. Base determination: task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (deterministic mapping); verified by parameter-set dump: Chen2020 = 4.2 V upper cut-off NMC811/graphite, has SEI kinetics (aging-capable), no plating params (runner injects standard defaults). Props source: baseline (literature values in Chen2020 set). Ceiling assessment (round 1): baseline contract ED = 400.29 Wh/kg >= 392.61 already -> ED is architecture-achievable without material escalation; the binding failure is 4C plating (anode_potential_v min -0.4385 V during 4C charge from fully-discharged state) - gap attribution: anode transport/kinetic polarization at 20 A is a cell-level (Stage 3) property (particle size / electrolyte transport / N-P / cooling), so no Stage 2 escalation at this point; overcharge 4.7 V does not trigger thermal runaway at baseline.
